name: SRT Sandbox
description: Docker-free local sandbox backend for OpenClaw built on the Anthropic Sandbox Runtime (macOS Seatbelt).

binShell.label: Shell
binShell.help: Absolute path to the POSIX shell used to run sandboxed commands. Defaults to /bin/bash.

network.label: Network
network.help: Network posture for sandboxed commands. 'deny' blocks all outbound network (default); 'allow' leaves it open. macOS/Linux only; Windows execution rejects every network mode before native setup.

allowedDomains.label: Allowed Domains
allowedDomains.help: Domains allowed when network is deny. An empty list denies all outbound network. macOS/Linux only; Windows execution rejects every network mode before native setup.

writablePaths.label: Extra Writable Paths
writablePaths.help: Additional absolute paths added to the sandbox writable allowlist beyond the scope workspace directories.

perSessionNetwork.label: Per-session Network
perSessionNetwork.help: Run each session with an isolated SRT network broker. macOS/Linux only; Windows execution rejects every network mode before native setup.

parentProxy.label: Parent Proxy
parentProxy.help: Optional upstream HTTP/HTTPS proxy for per-session network brokers. macOS/Linux only; Windows execution rejects every network mode before native setup.

windows.label: Windows
windows.help: Reserved Windows discovery settings. Native execution is disabled with SRT 0.0.76 because shared account, credential, WFP and ACL setup has no exclusive ownership or retirement-safe rollback contract. proxyPortBase has no runtime effect.
